lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance white circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of white blobs on the posterior-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank showing a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple reddish-pink pixel clusters, likely parasitic copepods, visible on the head and anterior flank region.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense distribution of high-luminance spots across the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
